actions.description: Create a new review for a product.
actions.name: create-review

shop_domain.description: Shop domain associated with the review. Example: "fngeneration.myshopify.com"

external_id.description: The external (e.g. Shopify) product ID to attach the review to.

ActionInput_judgeme_oauth_createreview.description: Input for creating a new product review.

message.description: Status message from Judge.me indicating the review is being processed.

ActionOutput_judgeme_oauth_createreview.description: Response confirming the review creation request was accepted.

actions.description: Register a webhook subscription for a review lifecycle event.
actions.name: create-webhook

event.description: Review lifecycle event to subscribe to. Example: "review/created"

callback_url.description: The URL Judge.me will POST to when the event occurs.

ActionInput_judgeme_oauth_createwebhook.description: Input for creating a Judge.me webhook subscription.

shop_id.description: Judge.me internal ID of the shop.

shop_domain.description: Domain of the shop the webhook belongs to.

id.description: Judge.me internal ID of the webhook.

failure_count.description: Number of consecutive failed delivery attempts.

key.description: The event key this webhook is subscribed to.

url.description: The callback URL Judge.me will POST to when the event occurs.

ActionOutput_judgeme_oauth_createwebhook.description: Output of a created Judge.me webhook subscription.

actions.description: Remove a webhook subscription by id.
actions.name: delete-webhook

id.description: The Judge.me internal identifier of the webhook subscription to remove. Example: 12345

ActionInput_judgeme_oauth_deletewebhook.description: Input to remove a webhook subscription by its Judge.me id.

ActionOutput_judgeme_oauth_deletewebhook.description: Empty response indicating the webhook was removed.

actions.description: Fetch the ready-to-render review widget/badge HTML for one or more products.
actions.name: get-product-review-widget

items.description: External product ID, typically the Shopify product ID. Example: "10291926270247"

external_ids.description: One or more external product IDs to fetch review widgets for (maximum 100 per call, to stay within the action output size limit).

ActionInput_judgeme_oauth_getproductrevi.description: Input for fetching product review widgets.

product_external_id.description: The external product ID that the widget belongs to.

widget.description: XSS-safe, ready-to-render review widget HTML for the product.

widgets.description: Review widgets for the requested products, in the same order as the input IDs.

actions.description: Fetch a single product by its Judge.me product id
actions.name: get-product

ActionInput_judgeme_oauth_getproduct.description: Input for fetching a single Judge.me product by its internal id

in_store.description: Whether the product is available in the store

excluded.description: Whether the product is excluded from Judge.me

actions.description: Fetch a single review by its Judge.me review id.
actions.name: get-review

review_id.description: The Judge.me review id to fetch. Example: 1306610400

ActionInput_judgeme_oauth_getreview.description: Input for fetching a single Judge.me review by its id.

rating.description: The star rating given by the reviewer, typically 1–5.

reviewer_email.description: The email address of the reviewer.

product_id.description: The external product id associated with this review.

product_title.description: The title of the reviewed product.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the review was created.

published.description: Whether the review is publicly visible.

ActionOutput_judgeme_oauth_getreview.description: A single Judge.me review including rating, content, reviewer, and product details.

actions.description: Fetch a single reviewer profile by id.
actions.name: get-reviewer

id.description: Judge.me internal ID of the reviewer.

ActionInput_judgeme_oauth_getreviewer.description: Input for fetching a single reviewer profile by id.

id.description: Judge.me internal ID of the reviewer.

accepts_marketing.description: Whether the reviewer accepts marketing communications.

unsubscribed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the reviewer unsubscribed from marketing.

ActionOutput_judgeme_oauth_getreviewer.description: A single reviewer profile from Judge.me.

actions.description: Fetch specific named settings for the shop.
actions.name: get-shop-settings

setting_keys.description: Non-empty list of setting keys to fetch. Example: ["widget_theme", "badge_position"]

ActionInput_judgeme_oauth_getshopsetting.description: Input to fetch specific named settings for the shop.

settings.description: Map of requested setting keys to their values. Unrecognized keys are omitted.

ActionOutput_judgeme_oauth_getshopsettin.description: Output containing the requested shop settings.

actions.description: List orders known to Judge.me for this shop within a date range.
actions.name: list-orders

start_date.description: Start of the date range to filter orders, in dd/mm/yyyy format. Example: "01/01/2024".

end_date.description: End of the date range to filter orders, in dd/mm/yyyy format. Example: "31/01/2024".

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (page number) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

per_page.description: Number of orders per page. Maximum 100, default 10.

ActionInput_judgeme_oauth_listorders.description: Input for listing orders from Judge.me.

start_date.description: Start of the date range covered by this response.

end_date.description: End of the date range covered by this response.

per_page.description: Number of orders returned per page.

external_id.description: External order ID from the shop platform.

fulfilled_at.description: Date when the order was fulfilled.

cancelled_at.description: Date when the order was cancelled.

reviewer_id.description: Reviewer ID associated with the order.

created_at.description: Date when the order was created.

updated_at.description: Date when the order was last updated.

orders.description: Array of orders known to Judge.me for this shop.

next_cursor.description: Cursor to try next. Omitted when this page returned fewer results than per_page. The provider does not expose a total count, so a present value means another page is possible, not guaranteed — it may come back empty.

ActionOutput_judgeme_oauth_listorders.description: Output for listing orders from Judge.me.

actions.description: List products known to Judge.me for this shop.
actions.name: list-products

cursor.description: Page number from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

per_page.description: Number of items per page (max 100, default 10).

in_store.description: Whether the product is available in the store.

excluded.description: Whether the product is excluded from Judge.me.

products.description: List of products known to Judge.me for this shop.

next_cursor.description: Cursor to try next. Omitted when this page returned fewer results than per_page. The provider does not expose a total count, so a present value means another page is possible, not guaranteed — it may come back empty.

actions.description: List reviews for the shop with optional filters
actions.name: list-reviews

page.description: Page number for offset pagination (starts at 1)

per_page.description: Number of reviews per page (max 100, default 10)

product_id.description: Filter reviews by Judge.me internal product ID

current_page.description: Current page number in the paginated result set

per_page.description: Number of reviews returned per page

product_external_id.description: External platform product ID the review belongs to

accepts_marketing.description: Whether the reviewer accepts marketing emails

unsubscribed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the reviewer unsubscribed

source.description: Origin of the review such as web, api, or import

curated.description: Curation or publish status of the review

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the review was created

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the review was last updated

urls.description: Map of picture size keys to public image URLs

reviews.description: List of reviews for the current page

next_page.description: Page number to try next. Omitted when this page returned fewer results than per_page. The provider does not expose a total count, so a present value means another page is possible, not guaranteed — it may come back empty.

ActionOutput_judgeme_oauth_listreviews.description: Paginated list of reviews for the shop

actions.description: List webhook subscriptions configured for the shop.
actions.name: list-webhooks

id.description: Judge.me internal ID of the webhook subscription.

key.description: Event type key, for example review/created or review/updated.

url.description: URL where the provider delivers event payloads.

failure_count.description: Number of consecutive failed delivery attempts.

webhooks.description: Webhook subscriptions configured for the shop.

review_id.description: Judge.me internal review ID to publish. Example: 1306611514

actions.description: Post a public reply to a review, shown on the storefront widget.
actions.name: reply-to-review

review_id.description: Judge.me internal ID of the review to reply to. Example: 111

content.description: The public reply body text shown on the storefront widget. Example: "Thanks for the review!"

send_reply_email.description: Whether to send an email notification to the reviewer. Defaults to true.

ActionInput_judgeme_oauth_replytoreview.description: Input for posting a public reply to a Judge.me review.

actions.description: Resolve a platform product id to the internal Judge.me product id.
actions.name: resolve-product-by-external-id

external_id.description: The external platform product ID to resolve. Example: 10291926270247

ActionInput_judgeme_oauth_resolveproduct.description: Input for resolving a product by its external platform ID.

external_id.description: The external platform product ID that was resolved.

actions.description: Send a manual review request email for an order.
actions.name: send-manual-review-request

reviewer_name.description: Customer name to display in the review request.

reviewer_email.description: Customer email address to send the review request to.

shopify_product_id.description: Shopify product external ID. Provide this or product_handle.

product_handle.description: Product handle slug. Provide this or shopify_product_id.

fulfilled_at.description: Order fulfillment date in dd/mm/yyyy format.

quantity.description: Quantity of the purchased product. Defaults to 1.

order_number.description: Order number to associate with the request.

success.description: Whether the manual review request was queued successfully.

ActionOutput_judgeme_oauth_sendmanualrev.description: Result of sending a manual review request email.

actions.description: Send a private email reply to a reviewer instead of posting publicly.
actions.name: send-private-review-reply

email_body.description: Body content of the private reply email sent to the reviewer.

email_subject.description: Subject line of the private reply email sent to the reviewer.

review_id.description: Judge.me internal ID of the review to reply to.

send_private_email.description: Whether to send the reply as an email to the reviewer. Defaults to true.

review_id.description: Judge.me internal ID of the review that was replied to.

actions.description: Hide a published review from the storefront.
actions.name: unpublish-review

message.description: Result message from the API indicating the action was performed successfully.

ActionOutput_judgeme_oauth_unpublishrevi.description: Output confirming the review was hidden.

syncs.description: Sync orders known to Judge.me for the shop.

id.description: The stable Judge.me internal identifier for the order.

id.description: The unique identifier of the product in Judge.me.
